name: Bass Weight
description: A bass held steady and thickened: moderate compression, the valve at its knee for the second and third harmonics that carry a low note on small speakers, and the warm voice.

name: Drum Bus Thicken
description: The kind's own use: a drum bus squeezed by a few dB with the valve driven into its knee, so the hits fatten and the room comes up between them. The fat voice lifts the kick and the cymbals' air a little.

name: Light Glue
description: Slow and light, with the valve nearly clean and no tone curve: it holds a bus together and adds little of its own.

name: Mix Bus Warmth
description: For a whole mix: a decibel or two of slow compression and the valve barely bent, with the warm voice taking the edge off the top.

name: Parallel Blow
description: Crushed hard and fast, the valve well past its knee, and a third of it mixed under what went in: the hits keep their front and the body between them swells.

name: Room Crush
description: Everything at once for a room microphone: limited, driven, and brightened, the tails pulled up to the hits. Half of it under the dry room.

name: Snare Bite
description: A slow attack lets each hit's crack through before it takes hold, a quick release lets go before the next, and the valve adds bite on the top.

name: Vocal Glow
description: A light, slowish squeeze and a little valve: the voice sits forward and a touch brighter without sounding compressed.
